text:
mia: Quick sync — need confirmation on emergency cutoff for feature flag smart-route-v2. If we need to flip off in prod who's allowed and what's the exact command + audit trail? Planning a 3pm canary, but want guardrails. @sam @raj

sam: Oncall + infra-sre team can flip. Use prod-toggle service (internal). Example:
```
curl -X POST https://prod-toggle.internal/flags/smart-route-v2/disable \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"reason":"DB spike","by":"oncall"}'
```
Will write an audit entry.

raj: Where does that audit show up? We need immutable trail for SOC. Also TTL for rollback? :eyes:

oncall-bot: Automated audit created: id=ae3f9c, actor=sam, action=disable, flag=smart-route-v2, ts=2176543305

security-lead: Confirming — only those with role feature-ops or infra-admin can call prod-toggle. Must include reason and ticket link. If it's >15min downtime or customer-impacting, escalate to @leo (SRE manager) and open incident. :lock:

ops-jordan: For canary audience — if flipping partial we use the rollout key "canary-group" with max 10% and health checks. Use:
```
curl -X POST https://prod-toggle.internal/flags/smart-route-v2/rollout \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"percent":10,"groups":["canary"]}'
```
Keep rollback window 30m.

mia: Good. Couple quick Qs: 1) Who's responsible for notifying product/CS? 2) Where do we log the ticket id? 3) Any monitoring dashboards to watch?

sam: 1) Oncall to ping #product-incidents + update the ticket. 2) Put ticket in the reason field and in PR description if any. 3) Watch /dashboards/flags-health & latencies, set alert: flags.smart-route.errors > 10/min

raj: Can we add an automatic fallback? If error-rate > threshold 3x in 5m auto-disable? Is that live?

ops-jordan: Auto-fallback exists but only for trained models; for route flags we can enable circuit-breaker in edge proxy. Needs infra change — not togglable by oncall. Filing infra task now: https://issues.internal/INFRA-4721

security-lead: Also, ensure KMS logs for token usage are retained. Add HSM audit requirement in runbook.

mia: Awesome. I'll update runbook here: https://runbooks.internal/flags/smart-route-v2 and add a checklist. I'll assign follow-ups. :thumbsup:

leo: Thanks all. Quick reminder — only flip if SLO is violated and mitigation won't help. Notify me for any customer-impact. :eyes:
